title: Faro — Frontend Observability
description: Self-hosted mimic of Grafana Cloud Frontend Observability (FEO11y), over Loki service_namespace="faro". Rows: Overview, Core Web Vitals (p75, thresholded), Errors, Sessions, Page performance, Page load + HTTP. Only resource attrs are indexed LABELS; kind and the Faro line fields are STRUCTURED METADATA / logfmt fields — filter kind with `| kind="…"` and the rest with `| logfmt | field=~"…"`. Web-vital p75 thresholds follow web.dev.
